markets.rules_primary: If Hou Yifan is rated top 5 on the February 2027 FIDE Top Women Players (top 100 players) Standard Rating List, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
According to FIDE regulations, when players have equal Elo ratings on the FIDE Top Women Players Standard Rating List, the tiebreaking methodology is as follows:
Number of rated games played - The player who has played more rated games in the rating period is ranked higher
Date of birth - If the number of games is also equal, the younger player (later birth date) is ranked higher
Alphabetical order by surname - If both criteria above are still tied, players are ordered alphabetically by their family name

markets.rules_primary: If Vladislav Artemiev is rated #1 on the February 2027 FIDE Blitz Top Players (top 100 players) Rating List, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
According to FIDE regulations, when players have equal Elo ratings on the FIDE Blitz Top Players Rating List, the tiebreaking methodology is as follows:
Number of rated games played - The player who has played more rated games in the rating period is ranked higher
Date of birth - If the number of games is also equal, the younger player (later birth date) is ranked higher
Alphabetical order by surname - If both criteria above are still tied, players are ordered alphabetically by their family name

markets.rules_secondary:
This daily market uses The Weather Company's precipitation total for Ontario International Airport (KONT), California, for the reporting day dated February 27, 2027. Data is available at https://weather.com/kalshi under Domestic, Daily Climate, Ontario (ONT). The market resolves Yes if total precipitation is strictly greater than 0.00 inches.

Total precipitation includes liquid-equivalent rainfall and melted frozen precipitation. Trace amounts and missing daily values count as 0.00 inches, subject to the contract's data-error and contingency provisions. Forecasts do not count. Use the initial non-preliminary reported value, subject to the contract's material-error correction provisions. A Final label alone does not establish that the data is error-free. If no reliable data is available by expiration, the contract's last-fair-price provision applies.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early once official ballot placement is confirmed and no pending legal challenge could reverse the determination.

markets.rules_secondary:
For the market to resolve to Yes:
The candidate must be listed on the actual ballot that voters receive
The listing must be confirmed by the relevant election authority

The following will NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Merely filing paperwork or submitting signatures without official approval
Being eligible to run as a write-in candidate without official ballot placement
Appearing on sample ballots or unofficial ballots only

The market will resolve if it is announced that Brandon Johnson will be on Chicago's Feb 23, 2027 mayoral ballot, even if the vote has yet to happen.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Treasury securities holdings reported for Japan for December 2026 are above the holdings reported for Japan for December 2025 in the same first non-preliminary edition of Table 5 that contains December 2026 data, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For this market, an increase means that the December 2026 figure for the named holder is strictly greater than its prior-year figure in the first non-preliminary edition of the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Table 5: Major Foreign Holders of Treasury Securities containing December 2026 data. Both figures will be taken from that same edition, including any revisions to the prior-year figure reflected there. “December 2026” refers to the table’s reporting period, not its publication date.

Values will be compared as published, in billions of U.S. dollars, without rounding. Holdings will be attributed exactly as Treasury reports them, without adjustment for custodial arrangements or beneficial ownership. For row matching, “Mainland China” corresponds to “China, Mainland,” “South Korea” corresponds to “Korea, South,” and “UAE” corresponds to “United Arab Emirates.”
markets.subtitle: Japan
markets.title: Will Japan's U.S. Treasury holdings increase in 2026?

markets.rules_secondary:
Additional clarification(s):

Drake appears on stage or in the official broadcast or stream; AND

Drake actively and perceptibly contributes to a musical performance by singing (including audible lead or backing vocals), rapping, playing a musical instrument, DJ-ing, or conducting a live band; AND

Is either a scheduled performer, a guest appearance during another artist's set, or is formally announced as a performer by official event organizers or Drake's official representatives.

Note: This Contract may resolve on the announcement of Drake’s anticipated performance at the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027. If an announced Drake later withdraws from the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027, this will not affect the resolution of the Contract.

The following constitutes a performance and IS encompassed by the Payout Criterion:

A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A collaborative or joint performance in which Drake is physically present and actively contributes musically.

A guest appearance during another artist's set in which Drake performs at least one full verse, chorus, or musical segment.

A medley in which Drake is present and actively performing, even if Drake's portion is partial.

A performance in which Drake performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027.

A DJ set in which Drake is the performing DJ operating equipment live, regardless of whether Drake sings.

A pre-recorded performance segment presented as part of the official event program, provided it is attributed to Drake by the official event organizers and presented as a performance (rather than a tribute, retrospective, or archival clip).

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.

A performance at a rescheduled version of the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027 where the reschedule occurs within one year of the original event date, pursuant to the postponement provisions below.

markets.early_close_condition: The market will close and expire early once the 2026-27 Offensive Player of the Year is announced.
markets.rules_primary: If the Pro Football Offensive Player of the Year in the 2026-27 season is on a team in the AFC, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on the conference of the team the Offensive Player of the Year winner is a member of at the time the award is announced, regardless of which team(s) they played for earlier in the season.

If co-winners are announced and both play for teams in the same conference, that conference will resolve Yes. If the co-winners' teams are in different conferences, each corresponding conference market resolves Yes at a value of 1/N, where N is the number of distinct conferences among the tied winners.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods trade deficit with China for calendar year 2026 is below $150 billion, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the calendar-year 2026 U.S. goods trade deficit with China, as calculated from the U.S. Census Bureau’s “Trade in Goods with China” table.

For the purposes of this market, the deficit equals: 2026 imports from China minus 2026 exports to China

The market resolves to Yes if that amount is less than $150 billion. The market resolves to No if that amount is greater than or equal to $150 billion.

Data are nominal and not seasonally adjusted. Revisions published after the first annual 2026 value is released will not be considered.

markets.rules_primary: If the United States and Iran hold a China-mediated senior-level diplomatic meeting after Issuance and before Feb 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify, unless the new article itself explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of the publication date. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The meeting must be deliberately convened for diplomacy or negotiation, and each country must be represented by at least one senior official who actively participates in an official capacity. It need not produce an agreement, joint statement, or commitment to further talks. Only the part of a meeting held after Issuance counts; a meeting held entirely before Issuance does not qualify, even if reported afterward.

A senior official is a head of state or government, vice president, foreign minister or other cabinet-rank minister, head of a national security council, presiding officer of a national legislature, special envoy, or anyone the head of state or government designates to conduct diplomatic negotiations on their behalf. Officials whose mandate is limited to technical, implementation, monitoring, staff-level, or preparatory discussions do not qualify. Qualifying officials include, without limitation, Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, Steve Witkoff, and Jared Kushner for the United States, and Mojtaba Khamenei, Masoud Pezeshkian, Abbas Araghchi, and Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf for Iran.

The meeting may be direct, with the officials meeting face to face in person (interpreters permitted), or indirect, with both delegations physically present in the same facility, venue, or city for a single organized round of talks and an intermediary authorized by both governments relaying communications between them on the same calendar day in the meeting location's local time.

The meeting must be mediated by China, meaning the Chinese government hosts or convenes it, or a Chinese government official (for example Foreign Minister Wang Yi or Special Envoy Zhai Jun) takes part as a mediator or intermediary between the two delegations. A meeting mediated only by other parties, or one that Chinese officials merely observe or attend without a mediating role, does not qualify. Proposing, encouraging, or initiating talks that another country hosts and mediates does not count as China convening them. Hosting a broader summit or conference alongside which the two sides meet does not by itself count as hosting the meeting.

Phone or video contact, chance encounters, and exchanges limited to greetings, courtesies, or photo opportunities do not qualify, nor do the proceedings of standing international organizations or recurring multilateral summits such as the UN General Assembly. A separately arranged bilateral meeting held alongside such an event may qualify. A meeting does not qualify if either country is represented only by persons lacking authority to conduct diplomacy or negotiation on its behalf. The incidental presence of supporting staff does not by itself disqualify a meeting.
